description: This file defines custom attributes for redacting property values in options classes within the Orleans framework. It includes the RedactAttribute base class and the RedactConnectionStringAttribute derived class, which specifically redacts connection string values.

classes.name: RedactAttribute
classes.description: An attribute that, when applied to a property, prevents its value from being formatted by IOptionFormatter instances.

classes.name: RedactConnectionStringAttribute
classes.description: A specialized attribute that redacts connection string property values using a utility method.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Returns a redacted string for the given value; overridden in derived classes to provide specific redaction logic.
